title: Maavan Putran Bajon Keeway Jundiyan Nay Asghar
body:
Rondi Paiyan Khaak Tey Bay Kay
Teri Yaadan Dil Chay Lay Kay
Chaliyan Shaam Nu Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad Anda Menu Asghar
Tere Son Da Vela Bachra (x2)
Keway Raat Nu Kaliya Soowan
Khali Peenga Tak Kay Roowan
Chad Kay Tur Gayo Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera Jhoola Tere Bajon
Tera He Taboot Baniya (x2)
Karbala Vich Qabar Bana Kay
Tapti Raitan Mu Tey Paa Kay
Roya Piu Tera Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Baniya Nai Yeh Teer Naiza
Laal Lay Tu Talwar Asghar (x2)
Aisi Bachra Jang Vakhavin
Deen Nanay Da Bachawin
Apnay Gal Naal Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Wada Keeta Jera Bibi
Poora O Mumtaz Ker Gai (x2)
Rondi Reh Gai Dard Satai
Dhup Ton Jad O Chaan Tay Ayee
Mar Gai Maan Teri Asgher
